plans.note: The single Ultra plan until 2026-05-19, when Google split it into the $100 and $200 tiers below.

schedule.note:
DeepSeek announced on 2025-02-26 at 11:25Z: "Starting today, enjoy off-peak discounts on
the DeepSeek API Platform from 16:30–00:30 UTC daily: DeepSeek-V3 at 50% off, DeepSeek-R1
at a massive 75% off." The archived pricing page of 2025-02-26T11:11Z lists the discount
(https://web.archive.org/web/20250226111135/https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing).
It printed R1's discount prices as $0.035/$0.135/$0.550, within 2% of an exact 75% off, and
said the completion time of each request decides its price. The discount ended with the
V3.1 price list at 2025-09-05T16:00Z (https://www.deepseek.com/en/news/deepseek-v3-1/).

Announced 2026-07-31, effective 2026-08-17 00:00 Beijing time, which is 2026-08-16T16:00Z.
The current rule is applied from that start. The pricing page first said peak hours applied
every day; "Monday through Friday" appeared between the 2026-08-22T13:06Z and
2026-08-23T18:11Z archives, and the holiday exclusion between 2026-09-17T23:31Z and
2026-09-19T10:10Z. No announcement introduced either change. See
docs/deepseek-pricing-history.md.

terms.en: Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
terms.zh: 空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半。北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）9:00 - 12:00、14:00 - 18:00 为高峰时段；其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段。

schedule.note:
Alibaba resells DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with "Busy hours" and "Idle hours" prices since
2026-08-17 00:00 Beijing time: "Peak hours refer to UTC+8 8:00 - 22:00, and off-peak hours
refer to UTC+8 22:00 - 8:00 the next day." Idle prices are half the busy ones, every day.
